title: THE TWELVE LABORS OF HERACLES — Mathematics, Language, and Logic: A Myth-to-Operator Omnibus
author: Mike Tate
edition: Universal Operator Codex | Working Omnibus | July 2026

core.thesis: The twelve labors are an escalating curriculum in operator selection, coupling, constraint, transport, and certification.
core.completion: Local closure at a declared scale, retaining a mismatch ledger and separating historical reference, formalization, analogy, and heuristic.
carryover: Lion skin becomes protective equipment for Cerberus descent
Hydra poison is a dangerous downstream residue
Hind and boar live-capture logic recurs in bull, mares, and Cerberus
Stables environmental redesign reappears in birds and cattle
Belt credential transfer reappears as delegation and rollback in apples
Cattle distributed transport precedes burden continuity and cross-domain return

labors.title: Nemean Lion
labors.operator_lesson: Type-check method; constrain field; convert obstruction into equipment

labors.title: Lernaean Hydra
labors.operator_lesson: Couple deletion to closure; separate regenerative nodes and irreducible kernels

labors.title: Ceryneian Hind
labors.operator_lesson: Preserve capture, noninjury, sacred custody, proof, and return

labors.title: Erymanthian Boar
labors.operator_lesson: Use terrain and timing to bring momentum into live-capture basin

labors.title: Augean Stables
labors.operator_lesson: Replace local carrying with flow and boundary redesign

labors.title: Stymphalian Birds
labors.operator_lesson: Make hidden state observable before selective precision

labors.title: Cretan Bull
labors.operator_lesson: Preserve provenance, reject substitution, track exported liability

labors.title: Mares of Diomedes
labors.operator_lesson: Interrupt cultivated feedback; separate restraint from stabilization

labors.title: Belt of Hippolyta
labors.operator_lesson: Protect authorization and common knowledge from adversarial corruption

labors.title: Cattle of Geryon
labors.operator_lesson: Preserve coherence and membership through distributed transport

labors.title: Apples of the Hesperides
labors.operator_lesson: Delegate burden, preserve rollback and restoration

labors.title: Cerberus
labors.operator_lesson: Cross a typed boundary lawfully without destroying guardian function

comparative_bridges.relation: Heracles operator-selection curriculum complements Theseus identity and recognition curriculum

constraints: Ancient sources are carriers, not claimed authors of modern mathematical formalism.
Preserve variant witnesses and historical source provenance.
Do not equate local formal closure with global proof.
Distinguish possession from legitimate custody and capture from stabilization.
Keep private original document outside public repository.
